register.notes: No state packaging register — the PRL covers only WEEE/batteries/tyres (v1 error fixed). Packaging compliance = Repak membership (or self-compliance route via local authorities for large producers).

notes: pro.rates left null: Repak sets membership fees on a pay-as-you-produce (tonnage × material) basis, but its per-material fee schedule is members-only and not published on the public site (checked 2026-08-16 — public pages show the Single-Use-Plastic producer list, not rate tables). Compliance = Repak membership OR self-compliance with local authorities for large producers. Ireland also runs a separate deposit-return scheme (Re-turn) for drinks containers, distinct from Repak packaging EPR.
